en: Oh, Heisen Stream, your waters so clear and fresh
Now and then, little fish swim to and fro
Little ducks turning round and round
There are turtles wading back and forth
Across the suspension bridge lies a forest
Oh, Heisen Stream, your waters so clear and fresh
Rice paddies on both sides, green upon green
I have no heart to read books
Watching white egrets fly back and forth
You gave me a happy childhood
Also gave me a beautiful mood
The years are like flowing water
Whenever it may be, it's time to go back
Using the paper of a little notebook
Setting it at the head of the stream

points.zh: 此詩是仿黃勁連的詩作「阮細漢兮時」。
points.en: This poem imitates Huang Jinlian's poem 'When I Was Young.'

points.zh: 黑森溪是屏東市郊的一條溪水，從舊時屏東醫院的後面流過。小學時候，阿姨在醫院當護士，放學後，常常去她的宿舍做功課，也到溪邊去玩。出國後，幾次回去屏東，只見市街和郊區已被繁華覆蓋，黑森溪也無處可尋。
points.en: Heisen Creek is a stream on the outskirts of Pingtung City, flowing behind what was once Pingtung Hospital. When I was in elementary school, my aunt worked as a nurse at the hospital, and after school I often went to her dormitory to do homework, and to play by the creek. After moving abroad, on the few occasions I returned to Pingtung, I found that the streets and the outskirts had already been swallowed up by development, and Heisen Creek was nowhere to be found.

points.zh:
台灣的搖籃歌謠中，有一首屏東民謠「搖籃仔歌」，就唱起黑森溪和黑森橋：
1. 搖仔搖仔搖，搖荖搖，搖來搖去，一搖搖到黑森橋，橋邊雙邊，樹木花蕊青笑笑，橋下一條，清清溪水流無休。
2. 搖仔搖仔搖，搖荖搖，搖來搖去，一搖搖到黑森橋，乖嬰仔古錐，親像花蕊吻吻笑，阿娘阿爹，無時無陣痛惜惜。
3. 搖仔搖仔搖，搖荖搖，搖來搖去，一搖搖到黑森橋，乖嬰仔賢大，暝大一寸日大一尺，粘麵會走，粘麵會跑也會叫 。
